summary: KNOREX Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated NYSE American-listed foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing an October 2, 2026 exchange agreement with holders North Commerce Parkway Capital LP and TQ Master Fund LP. The company swapped $3,150,000 of existing senior unsecured notes for $3,363,411 of new convertible notes, capitalizing $129,325 accrued interest and applying a 2.5% original issue discount, with no new cash. The notes mature January 1, 2027, convert at a 20% discount to VWAP with a floor and a 4.99%/9.99% ownership cap, and carry full mandatory prepayment from future financing or asset-sale proceeds. Watch for dilutive conversions and near-term liquidity pressure.
